unresolved_issues: These ten records do not establish complete machine-checkable ontology conformance; logical axioms and dependencies require specialist formal verification.
Source descriptions of worldviews and legal capacity are edition context, not current jurisdiction-specific law.
Active relationships remain held for the ordered corpus/reference audit.
extraction_completeness_status: complete for the registered bounded governance-relevant concept slice, not exhaustive formal ontology decomposition
schema_representation_limits: Natural-language EXTREQ records do not represent CLIF quantifiers, relation cardinalities, axiom dependency or ontology import semantics.
Definitional posture must control interpretation of imperative paraphrases and the legacy conformance alignment label.
taxonomy_gap_review: Formal norm conflicts, worldview-conditioned responsibility ascription and government legal-personhood maturity are conceptual/institutional matters outside operational invariant scope; no Fidelity Class created.
